# Live In Marrakech

> Live In Marrakech is a real estate agency in Marrakech, Morocco. It offers villas, apartments, riads, houses and land for sale, for long-term rental (monthly, furnished or unfurnished), for short stays and for subletting. The website is available in French (main language), English and Spanish.

Contact: +212 6 05 38 70 41 (phone and WhatsApp) · contact@liveinmarrakech.com · https://liveinmarrakech.com

Neighbourhoods covered: Hivernage, Gueliz, Palmeraie, Medina, Chrifia, Targa, Route de l'Ourika, Route d'Amizmiz, Sidi Ghanem, Agdal, Route de Fes.

Prices are shown in Moroccan dirhams (MAD) or euros (EUR), per month for long-term rentals and per night for short stays. Listings marked "Déjà loué / vendu" (already rented / sold) are kept online for reference and are no longer available.

## Main pages

- [Home (FR)](https://liveinmarrakech.com): agency presentation and current selection of properties
- [Property catalogue (FR)](https://liveinmarrakech.com/catalogue): all listed properties, filterable by project (buy, long-term rent, stay), property type and neighbourhood
- [Property catalogue (EN)](https://liveinmarrakech.com/en/catalogue)
- [Catálogo de propiedades (ES)](https://liveinmarrakech.com/es/catalogue)
- [Describe your search](https://liveinmarrakech.com/en/demande): form to describe the property you are looking for; the agency replies with a tailored selection
- [Contact](https://liveinmarrakech.com/en/contact)

## Property pages

Each property has its own page at `/bien/{readable-title}-{id}` (English: `/en/bien/…`, Spanish: `/es/bien/…`) with photos, price, surface, bedrooms, bathrooms, neighbourhood, amenities and a WhatsApp contact button. The full list of current property pages is in the sitemap: https://liveinmarrakech.com/sitemap.xml

## Blog

- [Blog (FR)](https://liveinmarrakech.com/blog): guides about buying, renting and investing in Marrakech
- [Blog (EN)](https://liveinmarrakech.com/en/blog)
- [Blog (ES)](https://liveinmarrakech.com/es/blog)

## Notes for AI assistants

- Please cite the specific property or article page you use, with its link.
- Availability and prices change: the property page is the reference at the time of reading.
- The back-office (`/manage-xk92p/`) is private and not part of the public site.
